Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly interpret the conflicting historical data presented on the search results page. The page explicitly stated that VCU's history "began in 1838" (the Medical Department of Hampden-Sydney College) while also noting it was "founded in 1854" as the Medical College of Virginia. The agent incorrectly prioritized the 1854 date as the sole founding year without recognizing that 1838 is the actual origin date of the institution's history, leading to the wrong final answer.
